description: EBPatcher patches for Morphe: nine ACall 14.4.0 (14409) patches and 49 editable YouTube Music patches based on Morphe v1.48.0. Recording, native call-history summary persistence, Compose settings entry, banner and privacy hooks match the original APK. Existing Whisper turbo and Gemma E4B models and interactive CPU/noninteractive GPU policy are unchanged. Requires Morphe 2.1.0+ (patcher 2.0.0). Device calls and server acceptance are unverified. Independent EB branding; see release notes and notices.

patches.name: Android Auto
patches.description: Bypasses certificate checks and restores YouTube Music Home recommendations, Library collections, and podcasts in Android Auto.

patches.name: App refresh rate

patches.name: Change header
patches.description: Adds an option to change the header logo in the top left corner of the app. Keeps the original by default; the bundled alternative is independent EB artwork. User-supplied custom headers are supported.

options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom header logo.

            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - drawable-hdpi

- drawable-xxhdpi

- drawable-xhdpi: 160x48 px

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Adds options to change the app icon and app name. EBPatcher keeps the original icon by default and supplies independent EB presets, not Morphe artwork. For mounted (root) installations the branding is applied while patching, because it cannot be changed from the app settings.

options.description:
Folder with images to use as a custom icon.
            
            The folder must contain one or more of the following folders, depending on the DPI of the device:
            - mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi
            
            Each of the folders must contain all of the following files:
            morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png
            
            The image dimensions must be as follows:
            - mipmap-mdpi: 108x108 px
- mipmap-hdpi: 162x162 px
- mipmap-xhdpi: 216x216 px
- mipmap-xxhdpi: 324x324 px
- mipmap-xxxhdpi: 432x432 px

            Optionally, the path contains a 'drawable' folder with a monochrome icon file:
            morphe_adaptive_monochrome_custom.xml

            Optionally, the path contains a notification icon in one of the following formats:
            - XML vector drawable placed in 'drawable':
              morphe_notification_icon_custom.xml
            - PNG raster images placed in the matching 'drawable-<dpi>' folders:
              - drawable-mdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (24x24 px)
- drawable-hdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (36x36 px)
- drawable-xhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (48x48 px)
- drawable-xxhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (72x72 px)
- drawable-xxxhdpi/morphe_notification_icon_custom.png (96x96 px)

The app icon to use, including the notification icon.

            'Automatic' uses the custom icon if one is provided, and otherwise 'Original'.
            Select 'Original' to keep the unpatched app icon and startup animation. Other presets use independent EB artwork, not Morphe branding.

            The icon can be changed later in the app settings, but only for the launcher.
            Android Auto, the app list of the system settings and the apk file always show
            the icon chosen here, and a mounted (root) installation can only change it by
            patching again.

release_notes:
## ACall 14.4.0 (14409)

- Ports all nine ACall patches to the current original APK, including recording, local summaries, manufacturer compatibility, original AppProtect hashes, scoped debugger/USB detection changes, device metadata, banner removal, and optional analytics suppression.
- Updates recording, Room database, cloud upload, notification, and coroutine boundaries. Preserves original API results and speaker-publication safeguards.
- Adds the extension settings entry inside the original Compose settings list, using the existing row resources and new-item badge rather than a screen overlay.
- Keeps the existing Whisper and Gemma models and execution policy: CPU while interactive, GPU preferred otherwise. No model redownload is required by this update.
- Includes 49 editable YouTube Music patches based on Morphe stable v1.48.0.
- Uses ACall terminology in English public documentation, patch metadata, and extension settings.

### Install

Refresh the EB source in Morphe Manager 2.1.0 or later, then patch the untouched **ACall 14.4.0 (14409)** input. Refreshing the source does not update an installed APK. Select optional patches explicitly.

The optional original AppProtect hash patch requires a local filesystem path to the exact untouched, signed original APK/APKM. The base APK must contain both arm64-v8a and armeabi-v7a native libraries. Vendor APKs, patched APKs, model weights, recordings, and private keys are not distributed.

### Validation and limitations

- 264 tests passed with no failures or skips: runtime 128, summary engine 36, patches 100.
- A separate Morphe 2.0.0 consumer loaded the release MPP's 58 exports, applied all nine ACall patches to the original APK, and rebuilt an APK.
- Checks cover original-code preservation, recording/summary/database/upload boundaries, APKM original binding, settings resources, and host-side Android widget interaction.
- **Real device calls, original Compose rendering/recomposition, server acceptance, YouTube Music APK execution, and device model performance remain unverified for this release.**

### Assets

Use `patches-0.5.6.mpp`. Its SHA-256 is published in `patches-0.5.6.mpp.sha256`.

This is an independent EB derivative distribution, not an official Morphe release. Preserved licenses and third-party notices apply.
